q: How much CO2 does a CNG station's compressor add per kg of gas sold?
title: CNG station compressor CO2 per kg
short: Divide the compressor's monthly kWh by the kilograms of CNG dispensed, then multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. That is the station's Scope 2 per kg. Gas vented during maintenance is unburnt methane and counts in Scope 1. The CO2 from burning the gas belongs to the vehicle owner.
audience: CNG station operators and fleet owners

ul: Compressor sub-meter readings, or the station's electricity bill if the compressor dominates.
Kilograms dispensed from the dispenser totaliser.

p: Your Scope 1 is 2.69 kg CO2 per kg of CNG burned. The station's compression energy is upstream, Category 3.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
